products: Azure API Management AI gateway capabilities
capabilities.role: Govern model/API traffic and access supported foundation models.
capabilities.limit: The separate AI Gateway tier is public preview; do not conflate it with existing API Management gateway capabilities or assume all tiers support the same policies.

capabilities.role: Vector, keyword and hybrid retrieval.
Managed agent runtime, prompt agents, hosted agents and tools.
capabilities.limit: Managed orchestration and hosting your own agent code are distinct paths.

capabilities.role: Custom training scripts and managed model inference endpoints.
Evaluate models, agents, datasets or captured traces; inspect agent telemetry.
Converse supplies a consistent message interface for supported Bedrock models; AgentCore Gateway exposes agent-facing capabilities.
capabilities.limit: The Bedrock inference endpoint and AgentCore Gateway have different jobs; model-specific features remain.

capabilities.role: Managed retrieval and retrieval-augmented generation over configured data sources.
capabilities.limit: Vector backend and ingestion configuration remain architecture choices.

capabilities.role: Host agent applications and connect agent infrastructure services.
capabilities.limit: A runtime hosts an agent; it does not make arbitrary custom application code a correct tool loop.

capabilities.role: Train custom models and deploy inference endpoints.
Evaluate agent behavior and inspect instrumented sessions, traces and metrics.
capabilities.limit: Dataset evaluation runner is documented as public preview; distinguish it from the wider evaluation service.

platforms.label: Google Cloud
platforms.name_note: The checked Vertex AI Agent Engine, Model Garden, Vector Search, training and evaluation documentation URLs redirect to Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Preserve Vertex AI / Agent Engine as discovery aliases, not assumed current page titles.

capabilities.role: Access managed or self-deployed models; govern configured agent connectivity.
capabilities.limit: Agent Gateway connectivity and Model Garden model access are distinct roles, not one interchangeable inference API.

capabilities.role: Managed vector similarity search.
capabilities.limit: Do not conflate this page with the separately named Agent Retrieval product, formerly Vector Search 2.0.

capabilities.role: Runtime hosts agents; ADK supplies agent and workflow building blocks.
Custom training and deployment of model weights on cloud compute.
Evaluate outputs and inspect agent execution traces, logs and metrics.

platforms.title: GCP

capabilities.role: Access and route requests to supported model providers.
Connect external providers such as Upstash Vector or MongoDB Atlas for vector retrieval.
capabilities.limit: These are provider integrations, not a Vercel-owned vector database. Provider regions, access and retention need separate review.

capabilities.role: Application-level tool loops, durable workflows and deployed application code.
capabilities.limit: AI SDK is an application library; it is not itself a hosted model or cloud runtime.

capabilities.role: Host the application and connect a model-serving or training service.
capabilities.limit: No general managed GPU training service was established by the reviewed docs. Do not draw a SageMaker/custom-training equivalent or a categorical impossibility claim.

capabilities.role: Inspect model calls, spend and application execution; connect telemetry and a chosen evaluation pipeline.
capabilities.limit: Request telemetry and spend are not answer-quality scores. Current AI SDK docs include experimental evaluation callbacks; this review does not establish a managed golden-dataset evaluation service equivalent.
